description: Vạch màu dọc mọc ra, dải tên tối quét vào từ trái, tag chức danh màu nhấn quét vào chậm hơn vài khung, chữ trượt nhẹ vào trong dải; giữ lâu rồi quét ra.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-lower-third, written here): Accent bar 4 × 50 px grows from its centre 0.3–0.55 s expo.out. Name plate (dark, 30 px, radius 2) wipes in from the left 0.35–0.75 s expo.out; role tag (accent, 16 px, 14 px indent) 0.52–0.92 s (≈5 frames later). Name (20 px) fades 0.45–0.7 s and slides −18 px → 0 (expo.out) inside its plate; role (11 px, light) fades 0.62–0.85 s, slides −14 → 0. Hold to 4.3 s (rule 5–7 s). Out: text fades 4.3–4.45 s, plates wipe off right 4.42–4.72 s, bar 4.5–4.75 s. Params: vào (0.3–0.9 s) · trễ chức danh (≈ 5 khung) · giữ (5–7 s) · ra (0.3 s). The role tag comes in about five frames after the name plate; plates wipe in from the left and off to the right (expo.out in, power2.in out).
